description:
Wishlist now on Epic Games Store. https://epic.gm/lotf2

Lords of the Fallen II is a dark fantasy action-RPG where brutal, soulslike combat collides with a world torn between life and death.

Watch the new Lords of the Fallen II trailer, The Battle for Thorngar, and journey deeper into a world consumed by war, divine conflict, and the ever-present threat of Umbral.

Discover Yisugen, a vast new region of towering pagodas, ancient traditions, and horrors twisted by the spreading darkness. Witness brutal combat, confront towering new foes including Lingao the Souring Storm, and get your first look at the highly requested katana weapon class in action.

One world. Two realms. No mercy.

author: Epic Games
description:
The latest creation from Fumito Ueda, creator of ICO, Shadow of the Colossus, and The Last Guardian. gen ATLAS is a single-player, open-world action-adventure game.

Without knowing why, you awaken on an abandoned planet. 

Before you lies a vast, silent world. Colossal structures stretch over endless plains, deserted facilities, and an ever-changing sea. The remnants of some grand design litter the planet’s surface.

Wishlist gen ATLAS now on the Epic Games Store! https://epic.gm/gen-atlas

description:
Mi Fu, Captain of the Wuling Watch, the trusted subordinate of Viceroy Tianshi Zhuang Fangyi, protector of Wuling, and a warrior who never retreats. Yet, she is also the "traitor" of Qingbo Stockade, as well as Tangtang's childhood friend and rival... Worthy opponents and friends worth fighting for — these are the two relationships that matter most to Mi Fu, and it is for them that she came to Endfield Industries.
